messages:
Nina (AE): AM check-in: quick pipeline notes — 4 active deals. Flags: NovaHealth needs KMS/HSM architecture doc for procurement; MacroHealth asking for Dedicated pilot ETA; demo env flaky for customer demo; Vega asked for updated Dedicated pricing slide.

Sam (AE): Quick updates: I sent preliminary pricing to Vega this morning. For NovaHealth legal asked for pen-test & SOC2 links — I pointed them to our SOC2 page. @Priya can you share the HSM integration summary?

Priya (Solutions Eng): On it. Short answer: we support external KMS via a KMS bridge and can do a sandbox HSM demo. Posting internal doc in a sec: https://redwood.internal/hsm-integration (internal). Sandbox demo ETA: EOD Fri if eng signs off on the gating PR.

Omar (Sales Eng): Blocker: demo failing on prompt routing; runtime returns 500 for larger payloads. Repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"<~6k tokens>"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```
Symptoms: 500 on long payloads, staging traces show routing error. Ticket: ENG-RUNTIME-1234.

Devon (Security): Pinged infra for pen-test artifact; we'll share once available. For NovaHealth KMS ask — need key-wrapping diagram + control-plane access list and ACLs. @Priya can you provide that by EOD?

Priya (Solutions Eng): Yep — will attach key-wrapping diagram + list of required firewall/IP entries. Note: some HSM vendors require customer IP allowlist.

Sam (AE): Can we get a short one-pager for procurement (KMS scope + security controls) so I can send to NovaHealth legal? If Priya posts, I’ll forward.

Nina (AE): Today: follow up w/ NovaHealth legal to confirm docs; confirm Dedicated pilot start date with ops; help unblock demo env; triage Vega pricing Q.

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy 2468012350: routing config update rolled out to staging :rocket:.

Omar (Sales Eng): Quick test: staging now returns 200 for the earlier repro. Tested 09:14 — ping @dev-team to verify prod rollout readiness.

dev-team: looking into logs & smoke tests now; will push fix to prod after verification. ETA ~2h.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Uploaded KMS/key-wrap diagram to internal doc repo and linked in thread (internal link). Drafting the procurement one-pager now, will post by noon. CC @Devon for security checklist.

Devon (Security): Thanks — please include: encryption-at-rest certificates, KMS rotation policy, audit log retention, and minimum network ACLs.

Sam (AE): :thumbsup: I’ll update the Vega slide after Priya's one-pager. Any objections to starting NovaHealth pilot next Tue?

Nina (AE): No objections from me. I’ll confirm with CSM and hold if legal needs more time — fallback: canary start after legal sign-off.

Sam (AE): Noted. I’ll keep Vega updated on pricing timeline.

Omar (Sales Eng): If prod rollout is green, I’ll schedule the demo for NovaHealth next Tue 10am PT. Otherwise hold.

Nina (AE): Thanks team — please drop any follow-ups here.
